name: contentstudio
description: AI-powered metadata generation for YouTube and Podcasts
//crucible-bootstrap: Exact @crucible/bootstrap 1.0.34 LIBRARY tarball, vendored so a build is reproducible. It is the code that PERFORMS an install and never the release that GETS installed: which Crucible a machine should have is the release channel's answer, read at install time (crucible docs/INSTALL-UNINSTALL.md 6.5). Never replace with a directory dependency or repack these bytes.
//crucible-client: CUT RELEASE 1.0.34: @crucible/client and @crucible/bootstrap are the vendored tarballs from crucible's v1.0.34 GitHub release (node tools/adopt-crucible-release.mjs <ver>, run from the repo root, fetches, repins and relinks). It is the LIBRARY this app is built against, NOT a statement about which server it needs: compatibility is the API version on X-Crucible-Api, and the SDK reads a field a server left out as null. Repin with the same tool, naming the version, never by hand (CRUCIBLE-MIGRATION-PLAN.md 3.1).

scripts.build:all: npm run build:electron && npm run build:preload && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start:electron: npm run build:electron && npm run build:preload && wait-on http://localhost:4200 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.package: npm run prepare:build-output && npm run clean && npm run build:all && electron-builder build
scripts.package:mac: npm run prepare:build-output && npm run build:all && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:mac-arm64: npm run prepare:build-output && npm run build:all && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.package:mac-x64: npm run prepare:build-output && npm run build:all && electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.package:win: npm run prepare:build-output && npm run build:all && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.package:win-x64: npm run prepare:build-output && npm run build:all && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.clean:package:mac: npm run clean && npm run package:mac
scripts.clean:package:mac-arm64: npm run clean && npm run package:mac-arm64
scripts.clean:package:mac-x64: npm run clean && npm run package:mac-x64
scripts.clean:package:win: npm run clean && npm run package:win
scripts.clean:package:win-x64: npm run clean && npm run package:win-x64
